description: Get a comprehensive overview of the project. Use include_bin_tree false or sequence_offset/sequence_limit for a bounded response on large projects.

include_bin_tree.description: Include the recursive bin tree (default: true). Set false to return project statistics and sequences only.

max_bin_depth.description: Maximum recursive bin-tree depth when include_bin_tree is true (default: 10).

sequence_limit.description: Maximum sequences to include. Omit to preserve the complete legacy response.

name: get_full_project_overview

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Get Full Project Overview
